narration.full_text: Namaste students! In this chapter, we're going to dive into the fascinating world of linear equations in two variables. By the end of this lesson, you'll be able to confidently define and formulate these equations, and solve them using various methods. We'll explore both graphical and algebraic techniques, including substitution and elimination. You'll also learn to analyze the conditions that determine whether a pair of equations has a unique solution, no solution, or infinitely many solutions. Finally, we'll tackle advanced word problems and graph-based questions, building a strong foundation for higher mathematics. Let's begin this exciting journey!
